title: Native HTML design and independent visual review
why: SDD-01 adds the HTML of a published research report, designed by Sophia's native designer and reviewed by a separate visual reviewer (docs/missions/2026-10-04-native-design, binding map). The page is a rendition of the report's next version, as a later PDF is: ArtifactRendition and every list of formats learn html, with the review state it was published with.

A design is a task kind of its own (design), with its progress (DesignProgress); a review is internal and never listed. A research task that was asked for HTML says what became of it (ResearchProgress.html, ResearchSubmission.html).

The runtime operations of both roles (/v1/runtime/design/*, /v1/runtime/review/*) authenticate and fence like research's. A source is checked by the API with a parser before it is stored, and refused with its findings when it breaks the static profile. Model calls reserve against the research lineage's allowance through the research reservation shapes.

The render runner names the formats it renders (RenderClaimRequest); a capture job (format png) uploads each PNG its receipt names and settles with the capture receipt. An older runner names none, is a PDF runner, and is never handed a capture.
Every property this amendment adds is omitted when it has no value, so an older reader reads every earlier record unchanged.

An HTML design's progress (SDD-01): the version it designs, its state, and each candidate with how its review went. Omitted for other kinds.
One deterministic finding about a source (@sophia/design): the static profile, coverage or scope.
